issue.title: sort_and_reorder raises TypeError when session-member siblings mix None and datetime start_time
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-1o5.5 (epic sase-1o5, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2), found while
fixture-building a pending question gate row; triaged and independently reproduced by
the sase-1o5 land agent at master 113d799b2c.

Root cause: `sort_and_reorder` in `src/sase/ace/tui/models/_agent_ordering.py:49` sorts
each parent's session-member follow-ups with `key=lambda a: a.start_time or ""`. When one
sibling has `start_time=None` and another has a `datetime`, the key mixes `str` and
`datetime`, so `list.sort` raises `TypeError`. The top-level sort a few lines above
already splits rows into with-time / without-time lists; the follow-up sort does not.

Fix: give the follow-up sort a total-order key (for example
`(a.start_time is None, a.start_time or datetime.min)`, keeping None-time members last,
or whichever placement the surrounding "oldest first" grouping intends) and add a
regression test in the `_agent_ordering` tests with mixed None/datetime siblings.

task_type_fields.impact: Any Agents-tab reload whose roster holds a session member without a start time (for example a not-yet-started gate row) beside timed siblings crashes ordering instead of rendering the session.
task_type_fields.repro:
Build a parent row plus two session-member children that share one `parent_timestamp`,
one with `start_time=datetime(...)` and one with `start_time=None`, then call
`sort_and_reorder([parent, child_a, child_b], [])`. It raises
`TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of 'str' and 'datetime.datetime'`
(reproduced with the workspace venv at master 113d799b2c).

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1o5.5 proposed it after hitting the crash while building a pending question gate row fixture; the sase-1o5 land agent reproduced it independently and it is not caused by that epic.
